title: Casper and the Harvest
author: Quentin Galloway
blurb: Bram Delacroix, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
